$$
\text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{\text{Operating Profit}}{\text{Revenue}} \right) \times 100
$$

$$
\text{Operating Profit} = \text{Revenue} - \text{Operating Costs} = 100\, \text{million} - 60\, \text{million} = 40\, \text{million}
$$

---

### Step 2: Apply the Formula

$$
\text{Operating Profit Margin} = \left( \frac{40}{100} \right) \times 100 = 40\%
$$

---

### Final Answer

$$
\boxed{40\%}
$$
